meta.title: Two Layers, and Only One Is Ours

views.label: The one edge
views.note: Astragentic dispatches sessions; the method inside each session is used, not built.

views.label: Same layer, no ranking
views.note: Every method box sits at the same height. No line touches Superpowers or others.

cards.title: One Layer Is Ours
items: Astragentic sits at the bottom, dispatching sessions against a tracker
Runtimes sit in the middle — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, interchangeable
Method sits on top, inside each session, and Astragentic uses exactly one

cards.title: No Node Promoted
items: Every node in the method band is the same size, same fill, same weight
mattpocock-skills gets no visual promotion for being the one Astragentic uses
Only the edge marks the relationship — not the box

cards.title: The Rest Sit at the Same Height
items: No line connects Astragentic to Superpowers or to others
Their absence of a line is the point, not an insult
Same layer, different choice, nobody ranked
